vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Let's count all the stars, before bedtime!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Can you show me two fingers?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Mmm. That star looks like a cookie. Can I eat it?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Ha ha! No, Bobo! Stars are far, far away, up in the sky.

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Hoo! Stars are giant balls of light. And our Sun is a star too!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Five little stars! A whole hand!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Show me five fingers! High five!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Oh no! A cloud! Where did the stars go?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Peekaboo! They are still there! Six stars!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Nine little stars... yawn... I'm getting sleepy.

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Let's count them all again, together! Ready?

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Now, a star number game! Find the number on the card.

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Not quite, Bobo! That's eight. Five is here!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: How many stars are on this card?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: One, two, three, four. Four stars!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Three! Like my three honey pots!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: And how many stars are on this card?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: One, two, three, four, five, six. Six stars!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Two clouds. Which cloud has more stars?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: This cloud! Five is more than two!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Two stars, and three more stars. How many stars now?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: One, two, three, four, five! Five stars!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Five stars. Oh! A cloud covers two of them. How many can we see?

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Five take away two is three!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: How many fingers on one hand?

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Two stars and three stars make...?

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: And how many stars did we count tonight?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Now it's bedtime. Let's count down, and say goodnight to the stars.

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: See you next time, on Tiny Sparks!
